learning_outcomes.text: Introduction of students to basic problems of environmental protection, causes and after-effects of changes in environmental as an effect of economic and civilisation development.
Presentation of possibilities and ways of environment degradation in the light of sustainable development.
has knowledge of management, including quality management, production management, logistics and conducting business activity;
can communicate using a variety of techniques in professional and other settings;
is aware of the non-technical aspects of the activities of a mechanical engineer, including, but not limited to, its social consequences and impact on the environment;

syllabus_topics: Legal conditions of environmental protection. General ecology.
Ecology of ambient air, earth and water. Ecological aspects of health. Kinds of environmental pollution (anthropogenic, industrial and natural.
Environmental pollution as a result of industry and road transportation. Effects of environmental pollution (acid rains, the greenhouse effect, ozone hole, smog)
Conception of sustainable development. Methods of recycling and waste disposal. Environmental management system (acc. ISO 14001 and EMAS).
teaching_methods: Informative and problem lecture containing discussion elements
assessment_rules: Achieving all required educational outcomes is the condition for passing the course. Obtaining positive grades from all forms of classes is equivalent to passing the subjects and obtaining the appropriate number of ECTS credits. The way of final grade calculation is determined by the resolution of the Faculty Council. Any final grade is made on the basis of written tests from the knowledge obtained at the classes.
